title: Account for conversion of debt into equity

items.concept: Initial recognition of convertible debt as straight debt; subsequent SL premium amortization schedule; period-end adjusting JE for interest and amortization (emphasis); partial conversion into equity at book value (no G/L); presentation
Number-variant twin—initial recognition of convertible debt at discount; SL amortization schedule; period-end interest adjusting JE; full conversion at book value (no G/L)

Period-end-style adjusting JE to the conversion date (accrue interest + amortize premium between interest dates); conversion settlement JE; induced conversion expense; classification of inducement vs extinguishment
Classification/measurement—APIC recognized on conversion equals carrying amount of debt converted minus par of shares issued
Classification—convertible debt recorded entirely as a liability; no proceeds allocated to equity for the embedded conversion feature
